properties.text: Here the base-image gets prepared to be added to the Dataset. Change settings or crop manually if necessary.

widgets_values:
# Consistent Character Creator 4.0 · BETA
### Krea 2 Identity-Edit

Turns **one reference image** into a 24-shot character dataset.

---

## How to use

**1 · Load your character**
Drop it into `LoadImage` in the green **INPUTS** group.
Check **Preview Image (Face Reference)**: it should show a head crop. If it shows
the whole picture instead, no face was found - upload a hand-cropped face into
**MANUAL FACE CROP** and set **USE MANUAL FACE** to true.

**2 · Describe the character**
`STYLE` - appearance: hair, clothing, render style.
`CLOTHES` - optional extras.
Each purple scene group has its own `PROMPT`.

**3 · Name and run**
Set `NAME (CHARACTER)`. Images land in `output/CCC/<NAME>/`.

---

## Models

| File | Folder |
|---|---|
| [krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/diffusion_models/krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors) | `models/diffusion_models` |
| [qwen3vl_4b_bf16](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors) **(bf16, has vision weights)** | `models/text_encoders` |
| [wan_2.1_vae](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors) | `models/vae` |
| [krea2_identity_edit_v1_2](https://huggingface.co/conradlocke/krea2-identity-edit/resolve/main/krea2_identity_edit_v1_2.safetensors) | `models/loras/krea` |

## Custom nodes

**ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit** (the edit engine) · **ComfyUI-KJNodes** ·
**ComfyUI-AutoCropFaces** · **Mickmumpitz-Nodes** · **Impact Pack** ·
**WAS Node Suite**

---

## Settings

1408 × 1408 · 10 steps · CFG 1.0 · euler / simple

**Stay at 2 MP.** Measured from 1 to 4 MP: likeness does not improve, and above
2 MP the model starts duplicating the subject.

## Known limits

- **Full-body shots**: the face is too small to hold detail. Upscale afterwards.
- **Anime / stylised characters**: the face detector finds nothing, so use the
  manual face crop. Automatic scoring is not possible for them either.
- **BACK-VIEW** intentionally uses only one reference. Giving a back-view prompt
  a face crop pulls the model into drawing a face.

nodes.title: READ ME - manual face override
widgets_values:
## Manual face override

`AutoCropFaces` does **not** fail loudly. When it finds no face it returns the
image unchanged, so `INPUT_FACE` silently becomes the whole picture.

**Check** `Preview Image (Face Reference)`. Full image instead of a head crop
means no face was found.

**Fix**: upload a hand-cropped face here and set `USE MANUAL FACE` to true. It
overrides both `INPUT_FACE` and `REF_Image`. Any size works.

Needed for anime and some 3D characters - the detector is trained on real faces.

nodes.title: MANUAL FACE CROP  (used when USE MANUAL FACE is on)
KREA2-EDIT INFO (BETA)
widgets_values:
# 🟩 BETA notes

Runs **ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit** (MIT, Ostris LLC) for generation.

⚠️ The CLIP must be the **bf16** Qwen3-VL build. The fp8 one has no vision
weights, and reference images silently stop working.

**Turbo only.** RAW mode was removed; steps and CFG are fixed at 10 / 1.0.

**No upscaler or face detailer.** Generate at 2 MP, refine elsewhere.

`kv_cache` on the patch stays **off** - it is only valid for LoRAs trained with
ai-toolkit's matching kwarg.
